AccessMode.description: How the UI reaches an original's bytes without IGNIS storing them (LANES_V2 §7).

oneOf.description: The browser streams from NASA (signed PSI S3 URL, NASA media library).
Through the Worker pass-through proxy (NTRS: no CORS); nothing is stored.
Only a link to the provider's page.

EvidenceSchema.description:
Wire tag of the knowledge documents. Wave K1 writes `evidence.v2`; `evidence.v1` (C0) documents
are still read. An addition of v2 (a field, a relation, a concept node, a new document type) is
refused under the v1 tag, so a v1 reader never receives a document it would misread.

oneOf.description: C0. Still read; new documents are written as v2.

Origin.description:
Who produced a payload. `synthetic_fixture` marks hand-made contract examples; such payloads (and
anything computed from them) can never be presented as NASA results or qualify a model.
Produced-by-the-system payloads are `system` even when their *data* is synthetic (that is
`EvidenceClass::Synthetic` / `TrainedOn::Synthetic`).

description:
Delivery of one source version. The identity stays the `Source` (geode URL + file version +
hash); `url` is a short-lived delivery detail and is never stored in a citation.

cors.description: The URL is readable by scripts from the app's origin.

expires_at.description: When a signed `url` stops working; re-resolve after it.

landing_url.description: "Open at NASA": the provider's own page for the source.

range.description: The URL answers HTTP Range requests.

title: SourceAccess
